description: Fix Messages/Conversations bugs - inconsistent user.id/user.uid usage in startChat, empty members array in new conversations, Firestore Timestamp handling for created_at in message rendering, and broken NewGroupSheet that uses Supabase RPC.
steps: In src/pages/Messages.tsx: Fix startChat() - change member_ids from [user.uid, otherId] to [user.id, otherId] for consistency. Add last_message_at: serverTimestamp() and last_message_text: null to the new conversation doc. The members array should be populated with profile info or left for the Conversation page to resolve.

In src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Add handling for Firestore Timestamp objects in message created_at. When messages come from onSnapshot, created_at will be a Firestore Timestamp (not a string). Convert it: use .toDate().toISOString() if it's a Timestamp, or fall back to the string value. Apply this conversion in the onSnapshot handler when mapping docs.

In src/components/dm/NewGroupSheet.tsx: Replace the supabase.rpc('create_group_conversation') call with Firestore logic - use addDoc to create a document in the 'conversations' collection with member_ids (array of all selected user IDs plus current user), is_group: true, title, created_at: serverTimestamp(), last_message_at: serverTimestamp(). Navigate to the new conversation after creation.

In src/components/dm/NewGroupSheet.tsx: Replace the Supabase profiles query with a Firestore query to the 'profiles' collection. Since Firestore does not support OR queries easily, search by username prefix using where('username', '>=', term) and where('username', '<=', term + '\uf8ff'). For the no-query case, show a helpful empty state.

In src/components/dm/VoiceMessage.tsx: Fix the VoiceRecorder to actually upload the recorded audio blob. Use uploadToCloudinary from src/lib/cloudinary.ts (it accepts File | Blob) to upload the recorded blob, then pass the returned URL to onSend.
acceptance_criteria: startChat uses consistent user.id for member_ids
Conversation page handles Firestore Timestamp objects without 'Invalid Date' errors
NewGroupSheet creates group conversations in Firestore instead of calling Supabase RPC
VoiceRecorder uploads audio to Cloudinary and passes real URL to onSend
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit and confirm zero errors
